content: Named Entity Recognition: The failing cases include mismatches between the tags “chapter” and “other”, and the tags “question number” and “other”. This type of error arose due to the imperfectly labeled span of a multi-word named entity. In such cases, the first or last word in the named entity was excluded from the span and erroneously labeled with the tag “other”.
